meta.name: Leeds
meta.counts_blurb: Average bikes per day from Leeds City Council automatic counters (12 months to the latest data where available), plus two DfT counts on the ELOR track. Green dots are off-road paths. Counters on one-way lanes count one direction only, so a road with two counters carries roughly their sum. Police collision data does not cover off-road paths, so they have usage figures but no safety rating.
